description: Free, open-source app for Apple Silicon Macs: local AI video with sound, songs and images. Includes LTX-2.5 and Hailuo H3.
summary: Run MiniMax Hailuo H3 and LTX-2.5 video generation locally on a Mac. Joint audio+video, character LoRA training, one-click Pinokio install. MLX — no CUDA, no cloud, no API key.
